items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Russell, another friend of ours, he's got the drum.

ctx.x: Straight tone, in there with that... And I used to see... I saw Joe Smith a couple of times, when the Cotton Pickers came to town. He went to Kansas City and met that woman and died out there. [JOE SMITH MOVED TO K.C. IN 1931, BUT LEFT WITH FLETCHER HENDERSON CIRCA 1936(?), AND DIED IN NYC IN DECEMBER 1937]

Then there was Luke Smith, the other brother. He played trumpet, but he was a gambler and stayed inn the Rhythm Club all the time. He looked like Joe and Russell. But he was a hustler and a gambler, well-dressed all the time. Luke.
